title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online Continual Learning (OCL) requires models to learn from non-stationary data streams under a strict single-pass constraint, making them highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. While existing studies have explored various strategies from data, architecture, and optimization perspectives, the optimizer often directly uses generic approaches such as SGD and AdamW. In this work, we reveal a new link between optimization dynamics and OCL needs by recasting Polyak-Ruppert averaging as the engine of "plasticity" and Primal averaging as the anchor of "stability". This inspires our novel optimizer, SPIN (Stability-Plasticity INterpolation), which explicitly decouples plasticity and stability by interpolating between a fast-moving "plasticity" sequence and an adaptive "stability" sequence. translated_title: 从通用到专用：一种面向在线持续学习的新型优化器
translated_abstract: 在线持续学习（OCL）要求模型在严格的单次遍历约束下从非平稳数据流中学习，这使得模型极易受到灾难性遗忘的影响。虽然现有研究已从数据、架构和优化等角度探索了多种策略，但优化器往往直接采用SGD和AdamW等通用方法。在这项工作中，我们通过将Polyak-Ruppert平均重塑为“可塑性”的引擎、将原始平均作为“稳定性”的锚点，揭示了优化动力学与在线持续学习需求之间的新联系。这一发现启发了我们提出的新型优化器SPIN（Stability-Plasticity INterpolation，稳定性-可塑性插值），它通过在快速移动的“可塑性”序列与自适应的“稳定性”序列之间进行插值，显式地解耦了可塑性与稳定性。我们从理论上证明，SPIN隐式地采用了逆Hessian近似，提供了关键的Tikhonov正则化来抑制带噪的更新……
tldr: 该论文提出新型优化器SPIN，通过在快速“可塑性”序列与自适应“稳定性”序列之间进行插值来显式解耦在线持续学习中的可塑性与稳定性，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPIN, a novel optimizer that explicitly decouples plasticity and stability in online continual learning by interpolating between a fast-moving plasticity sequence and an adaptive stability sequence, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
